name: fluent-bit-tail-pause
description: Card W47-TAIL-PAUSE-BINDINGS: the Fluent Bit in_tail pause/resume slice (input control, input worker, library start/stop and the in_tail plugin), audited as a separate slice over the unchanged fluent-bit profile at the export of 90978ac6a59e96d19621108f63e115eb4cd1c576 (tree 8d1f3cd78a00fcfb4095a39d3d0b3e7eaac80be4). Every distinct compilation configuration is kept, so the static and shared variants of the core files are separate units. Excluded explicitly: plugins/in_tail/tail_scan_glob.c and tail_scan_win32.c (textually included by tail_scan.c, never compiled on their own), plugins/in_tail/win32/*.c (MSVC only), and tests/runtime/in_tail.c (the recorded prepare route configures FLB_DEV without FLB_TESTS_RUNTIME, so the compile database has no record for it, and the fluent_bit library profile does not model the test harness). This file does not change the profile's audit.json 185-unit selection and claims nothing about concurrency.
